final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing one.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented letters and drops the combining accent marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because `vendor/README.md` says never to edit files there by hand. The root cause is that the vendored function strips every non-ASCII character.

The shop's `productUrl` also calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so accented product names there still lose their letters. You didn't ask about that, so I left it alone. If you want it fixed too, the same normalization can go in `src/shop/product-url.js`.
